name: agy-capsule
description: Read-only Codex context, cache, token, request, and generation metrics from local rollout telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Codex context and token usage locally
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native port of agy-capsule. It reads local Codex rollout JSONL files and exposes current context usage, cache hit rate, input/output/reasoning tokens, request counts, recent request timing, and session history through read-only MCP tools and a chat-facing skill.
defaultPrompt: Show my latest Codex context and token usage
How much context is this session using?
